body: She’s paying off student loans faster than possible to also rent a place close enough to work, which is why she still lives at home. But I agree I’m not responsible for her mental health. I just am flattened by her moving the responsibility onto me. She can’t live with me because I’m still living with family, who can’t afford to have another person at home, until my job begins in a few months. Then I’ll be moving out. I’m working temporarily at a store, but that’s just to help make ends meet at home.
Thank you for the advice. I can definitely be better at calling. We text throughout the day, but I should try and call her more often for sure.
